title: Blob bombs

# Blob bombs

# Introduction

Blob bombs are a type of Bombs that summon a creature on impact. The creature is aggressive toward the player.
They are crafted at a Workbench by using a Corked vial sold by The Bog Witch.

## List of Blob bombs

• Name: Blob bomb: Poison | Crafting: Corked vial x1 Resin x3 Blob trophy x1 | Blob: Blob | id: BombBlob_Poison

• Name: Blob bomb: Elite poison (x2) | Crafting: Corked vial x1 Resin x3 Blob trophy x3 | Blob: Oozer | id: BombBlob_PoisonElite

• Name: Blob bomb: Frost | Crafting: Corked vial x1 Resin x3 Drake trophy x1 | Blob: Frost Blob | id: BombBlob_Frost

• Name: Blob bomb: Tar | Crafting: Corked vial x1 Tar x3 Growth trophy x1 | Blob: Growth | id: BombBlob_Tar

• Name: Blob bomb: Lava | Crafting: Corked vial x1 Sulfur x10 Proustite powder x10 | Blob: Lava Blob | id: BombBlob_Lava

Categorias: Weapons, Bombs
